title: entitopia enrichment-policies
description: A top-level ARRAY of policies, not an object. Each entry names one policy and carries its Elasticsearch policy body under its type key.

items.description: One policy: its name plus exactly one policy-type body. Elasticsearch supports match, geo_match and range; only `match` is used here, and the others are declared so a future project does not have to edit this schema to be legal.

name.description: Policy id. A policy bound to a live pipeline cannot be deleted, so changing a policy's definition means deleting the dependent pipeline by hand first — see the README's open item.

indices.description: Source index for the enrich index. Goes stale silently: a policy still points at whatever index it was executed against, so a full reload can leave every policy sourcing from indexes days superseded.

match_field.description: The join key. An enrich index maps every field as keyword and reindexes _source verbatim, so what decides a match is the string each side's _source renders to, not either mapping.

enrich_fields.description: Fields carried onto the target document. A field omitted here is silently absent downstream rather than an error.
